structured.answer: Open an account at Pesagot and buy the "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125" fund every month. The page says about 86,045 ₪ after 10 years, but that's for its example of 10,000 ₪ today plus 500 ₪ a month, not my 30,000.

stuck.why: Pesagot is a name I barely know; Leumi, a big bank I trust, is only about 3,000 ₪ lower, so I nearly switched
Every fund shows a minus (−0.04%, −0.37%, −0.54%, −1,030 ₪); I couldn't tell if that means losing money
A big 79,910 ₪ 'נקודת ההתחלה' with Harel at Bank Jerusalem looked like a different answer from 86,045
The page uses 10,000 ₪ and 500 ₪ a month, not my 30,000, so the final number isn't mine
